text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Win Variation got injured during training.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Getting injured, of all things...
I'm so sorry for making you worry...
choice_data_list: Just to be safe, let's get plenty of rest today.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...That's true, but...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Can't I move around just a little bit, please?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's a scheduled training day,
taking a break just feels kind of unsettling...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
As for how my injury is doing, I'm totally fine!
...Please!
choice_data_list: To be safe, you should get some rest right now.
To be safe, you should get some rest right now.
If we keep an eye on things, then just a little...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
As for how my injury is doing, I'm totally fine!
...Please!
choice_data_list: To be safe, you should get some rest right now.
To be safe, you should get some rest right now.
If we keep an eye on things, then just a little...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If anything happens to go wrong,
even all my past efforts will come to nothing.
choice_data_list: Let's focus on healing that injury.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Effort to heal an injury...
I see...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That's so true!
Working hard isn't just about training non-stop, right?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I'll make sure to get plenty of rest!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I feel kinda fidgety...
Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Win Variation rested quietly in order to heal her injury.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's fine with me.
I'll proceed carefully too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, while carefully monitoring her condition,
we did some light training, but...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: —...gh, nngh...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry.
It seems I misjudged the severity of the injury."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I was too naive, su...
For now, I'll just rest up...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation's injury has worsened...
There is no choice but to rest for a while.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
Phew――
choice_data_list: With this training routine, everything should be fine.
With this training routine, everything should be fine.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes! There's no pain at all,
so I can keep going like this.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I'll continue to be careful.
I definitely want to avoid pushing myself and making the injury worse here!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation worked within her limits
to stay active and aim for her comeback.
